newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian c.bank sold $1 bn in August - Yasin.
newsitem.headline: Russian c.bank sold $1 bn in August - Yasin.

text.p: Russia's central bank sold $1 billion from its currency reserves on the interbank market in August, Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin told a news conference on Tuesday.
He did not give any other details.
Currency dealers said the central bank sold dollars towards the end of the month, after a faster than usual decline in the rouble undermined confidence in Treasury bills.
The central bank sets daily bid and offer rates for the dollar against the rouble, which it uses in trade with designated major banks on the interbank market.
These rates tend to determine the level of the rouble in the interbank market.
In late July central bank chairman Sergei Dubinin said net reserves in mid-July were $14.9 billion.
